cost_interpretation: All observed runtimes, including UNKNOWN, ERROR and late results; unmatched totals are not same-task speedup.

bootstrap.algorithm: For each eligible case log(median_baseline/median_candidate); median logs then exp. Draw 16 templates with replacement, retain both budget cases for each occurrence, apply frozen group/eligibility filters, median retained logs then exp. Percentile 95% CI uses linear interpolation on nonempty log statistics; empty draws counted explicitly.
bootstrap.seed_scope: One shared 10000-draw template sequence for every pair and group
